goal: Delete the following expenses from pro expense: Streaming Services, Unexpected Expenses, Pet Supplies.

initialization.initializedGoal: Delete the following expenses from pro expense: Streaming Services, Unexpected Expenses, Pet Supplies.

errors: Pet Supplies was not located during the available execution window.
Current-screen absence is insufficient to establish absence from the complete expense list.
evidence: Streaming Services and Unexpected Expenses deletion dialogs were confirmed using com.arduia.expense:id/btn_confirm.
assert_not_visible for Pet Supplies passed at the final scroll position (agent-assert_not_visible-43), but this proves only current-screen absence.
plan_updates: Scrolled through additional expense-list sections to locate Pet Supplies.
Stopped after collecting limited visibility evidence; the app was closed.

pre_plan.action: Open Pro Expense and navigate to the expense list.

success_criteria: Pet Supplies is located and deleted.

output.summary: Deletion flows were completed for Streaming Services and Unexpected Expenses. Pet Supplies was not located, and absence of all three expenses from the entire list could not be verified.
unmet_criteria: The Pro Expense expense list no longer contains Streaming Services, Unexpected Expenses, or Pet Supplies: full-list absence was not established.

errors: No complete-list inspection or equivalent final-state evidence establishes absence of all three expenses.
Pet Supplies was neither shown remaining nor conclusively shown absent from the entire list; therefore the goal is not proven satisfied or unmet.
evidence: Streaming Services was selected by name, its associated delete control was tapped, a Delete Items dialog was recorded in 000022-ui_snapshot.json, and the confirmation tap passed.

Unexpected Expenses was selected by name; 000037-search_artifact.json identifies its associated delete control at bounds [925,960][1017,1052]. The subsequent tap at (971,1006), Delete Items dialog, and confirmation tap passed.
Searches for Pet Supplies returned no matches in several individual UI snapshots, but the evidence does not establish complete-list coverage.

The final assert_not_visible for Pet Supplies passed and references artifacts/screenshots/screenshot-agent-assert-not-visible-43-prepare-before-action-1-95f9194d6dd8.png. This establishes only absence from the current screen.
The main agent reported an inconclusive result, consistent with the limited verification evidence.

pre_plan.action: Verify the supplied final-state goal using execution records and artifact excerpts.
success_criteria: Evidence establishes that the expense list no longer contains Streaming Services, Unexpected Expenses, or Pet Supplies.

output.summary: The evidence supports deletion flows for Streaming Services and Unexpected Expenses, but does not establish that all three named expenses are absent from the complete Pro Expense expense list.
